options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show important rules. This sign tells drivers to keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic when possible.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings show a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Stay alert and follow the flagger's directions.

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
